To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

we have determined the weight distribution of the dual of the cyclic codes derived from the BCH codes and the cyclic codes with Kasami parameters, respectively, obtained infinite families of $t$ designs, and determined their parameters.
we have obtained a new class of $2$-designs from a new class of cyclic codes, which have not been known before.
we have obtained a new infinite class of cyclic codes with two nonzeros and determined its weight distribution.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the construction of infinite families of $t$ designs.
the construction of $2$ and $3$ designs from codes.
the construction of $t$ designs by using cyclic codes, which may be helpful to the study on the existence of $t$-designs.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
we have constructed infinite families of $t$ designs with $t\leq3$ and $v\leq 15$ from two classes of cyclic binary codes with three non-zeroes.
, we obtain infinite families of 2-designs from the codes with parameters $(n, 2^m-2^k+1, d)$, where $k$ is a positive integer and $n=2^m-1$ is odd.
we have obtained infinite families of $t$ designs for $t=2,3$ from the codes derived from two classes of cyclic binary codes.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have found a new approach for constructing $t$ design from codes.
, we have obtained a large amount of $3$ designs with large parameters from the dual of the binary BCH codes, which are the largest parameters for $3$ designs known so far.
we obtain infinite families of binary $2$ designs with the parameters $(2^{2k+1}, 3\cdot 2^{2k}+2, \binom{2k+1}{2}, \binom{3k-2}{2}+1, \binom{k+2}{2})$ for any $k \geqslant 2$.
The main takeaway from our work is that

we can construct infinite families of affine invariant codes with a fixed weight distribution from the codes with two or three nonzeros, and then get infinite families of $t$ designs by taking the duals of these codes.
we can construct $t$ designs with $t>2$ by using cyclic codes.
the codes we construct from the dual of BCH codes have a very nice structure, and that they are affine invariant codes, which makes it easy to construct $t$ designs.
